description: Elektronische Fahrplanauskunft der LINZ AG LINIEN - Sollzeit (Linz) is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mobilitydata.gv.at. Travel information and/or stop departure times by means of transport from LINZ AG LINIEN in Linz’s urban area. Starting and finishing points can be stops, important points, addresses or geo-coordinates. Note: Lines L001, L002 and L003 are trams (BIM) lines. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Electronic timetable information from LINZ AG LINIEN — target time (Linz)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include LINZ AG, ÖPNV, Linz Linien, Sollzeit, Fahrplan, Öffentlicher Verkehr. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GTFS, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
